recipe.ghg_method: GWP100: IPCC AR6 for CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, SF₆; HFC/PFC retain source CO₂-equivalents. Biogenic CO₂ excluded. Production accounts; direct final-demand emissions calculated separately and included once in Whole economy. This release does not separately report biogenic combustion CH₄; its native combustion CH₄ row uses 29.8.
recipe.license_note: Aggregated derived indicators. EXIOBASE attribution and source-use conditions apply; source matrices and coefficients are not included.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of labour compensation, operating surplus and other net production taxes.
recipe.gdp_note: The source has negligible product-tax entries; the income aggregate is labelled a GDP estimate.
